zh: status_request：请求与回传证书状态的 TLS 扩展。
CertificateStatus：随证书一并发送的状态消息。
responder_id 空表：表示响应方由双方事先约定。
nonce 扩展：用于抵抗 OCSP 响应重放。
bad_certificate_status_response：状态不合格时中止握手的告警。
en: status_request: the TLS extension requesting and returning certificate status.
CertificateStatus: the status message sent alongside the certificate.
OCSP: the Online Certificate Status Protocol (RFC 2560).
Empty responder_id list: responders are known to the server by prior arrangement.
Nonce extension: helps resist replay of OCSP responses.
bad_certificate_status_response: the fatal alert when the response fails checking.
